links.comparator_used: Explicit prompt naming the guideline to follow, without the guideline text (generic prompt relying on the model's built-in knowledge)
links.outcome: Adherence to the target non-U.S. guideline recommendations in conflicting-guideline neuroradiology vignettes
links.effect: Restored accuracies above 90% across all models, after adherence to non-U.S. recommendations had declined sharply with explicit naming alone
links.quote: Providing the complete guideline text was the most effective mitigation strategy, restoring accuracies above 90% across all models.
